goal: Integrate dau-viet-db Flyway migrations V2-V4 into dau-viet-backend (Phase A, done) and implement Authentication & Authorization foundations: register/login/refresh/logout, JWT access tokens, refresh-token rotation with family revocation, roles LEARNER/CONTENT_ADMIN, GET /api/v1/users/me, admin endpoint gating, keeping public Historical Event APIs unauthenticated.

acceptanceCriteria.text: V2/V3/V4 migrations copied verbatim into db/migration, V1 unchanged, dau-viet-db/ kept in repo for provenance.
Flyway applies V1-V4 on empty Postgres; 13 new tables exist; lesson_versions immutability trigger fires (FlywayMigrationIT).
POST /api/v1/auth/register creates a LEARNER account: email normalized lowercase, unique enforced, BCrypt hash only, safe DTO returned, client-supplied role rejected 400, invalid input -> 400.
POST /api/v1/auth/login returns access+refresh tokens; invalid credentials and LOCKED/DISABLED accounts -> uniform 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS without account-existence leak.
POST /api/v1/auth/refresh rotates tokens: old token revoked, previous_token_id chain recorded, replayed/revoked/expired tokens rejected (family revocation on reuse).
POST /api/v1/auth/logout revokes the refresh session and is safe to retry (204 idempotent).
GET /api/v1/users/me requires valid JWT and returns profile without password hash or token secrets.

JWT: signed HS256 tokens, sub=user UUID, role claim -> ROLE_* authority; short-lived configurable TTLs; secret from env (JWT_SECRET); stateless; LEARNER blocked 403 on /api/v1/admin/**; public GET /api/v1/events* stays open.
Safe admin bootstrap: AdminBootstrapRunner (local profile + app.seed.enabled, ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD env, insert-only) + documented SQL fallback.
Tests cover the 15 required flows incl. registration/login/refresh-rotation/logout/role gating/public events; existing Historical Event tests stay green; unverifiable items reported NOT VERIFIED.
Docs updated: API_SPEC.md auth endpoints, backend-runbook.md auth config/bootstrap, no secrets committed.
